countingRules: Each entry records a public username, relationship, accepted review count, unaffiliated accepted review count, recurring reviewer status, merged contribution count, and immutable evidence URLs.
Count only a public issue, pull-request review, or merged contribution with an immutable evidence URL.
Do not count the fixture or result-card author as an independent reviewer of their own work.
Record relationship to PaperEdits and any material conflict; unaffiliated means the disclosed relationship is none.
A username may appear in the registry only after an accepted review, merged contribution, or public recurring-reviewer decision.
An empty registry and maintainer activity do not count as external adoption.
